name: Things take time — Logbook
summary: App Store listing for an iPhone logbook app that tracks habits, routines and metrics side by side with per-tracker analytics.
description: An App Store page for Things take time — Logbook, a productivity app by Chester How for tracking habits, routines, personal metrics and notes. All trackers appear together in a month grid with per-tracker analytics, and data stays on the device or in iCloud. Free with in-app purchases (monthly $2.99, lifetime $34.99).
